title: daily-scratchpad-gpu-ops-24
content:
2026-03-04
Quick daily scratchpad for infra/platform work (GPU ops focus). Mostly notes-to-self + short TODOs.

Top-of-day:
- Check cluster GPU utilization report (week cohort): nodes with >90% sustained on last 24h.
- Follow up w/ Priya on the spare GPU pool sizing calc (we may need +4 A100s next month).

TODOS (prioritized):
1) Capacity adjustments (high priority)
   - Review shard allocation for batch-serving prod-rt (podset-prod-batch). Looks like 3 pods hitting 95% GPU mem at seq_len 2048.
   - Action: scale up pool-dedicated-1 by +2 pods (A100s) during US business hrs for next 3 days. -> Create change in infra-catalog and schedule autoscaler tweak.
   - Ticket: INF-3421 (linked). Owner: Ethan. ETA: 2026-03-05.

2) Networking check (medium)
   - Intermittent TCP resets observed between region-us-west-1 and dedicated-nodes. Suspect MTU mismatch after recent VPC peering change.
   - Quick check commands:
     * curl -v --resolve serving.redwood.us:443:<ip> /healthz
     * sudo ethtool -k eth0 on node to inspect offloads
     * ip link show dev eth0
   - If MTU < 9000 on one side, coordinate with networking team for fix. Ping Luisa.
   - Ticket created: K8S-881 (investigation).

3) GPU driver/firmware (low)
   - Hold on rolling driver update until after validation on canary pool. Last driver 525.85 caused cuda 11.8 compat blip for some models.
   - Plan: schedule validation run on canary-gpu-2 with model-candidate: redwood/gpt-7b-quant.v2.

Quick notes / commands to copy into ticket threads:
- Kubectl snapshot: kubectl get pods -n serving -o wide --selector=app=batch-serving > /tmp/batch-serving-pods-$(date +%F).txt
- nvidia-smi query example: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv
- Check kernel ring stats: cat /proc/net/softnet_stat | awk '{print $1}'

Blockers / open questions:
- Do we have authorized headroom in billing for +4 A100s this quarter? (Finance approval needed). Priya to confirm.
- Can we enable prefix/KV cache at prod-batch route without regressing latency for short-chat workloads? Need perf run.

Meeting reminders:
- 11:00 AM catch-up with Platform (daily) — discuss autoscaler policy adjustments, confirm maintenance window for rolling scale.
- 3:00 PM infra sync with Networking — MTU issue follow-up.

Follow-ups (post-meeting):
- Draft brief for sales-eng on expected latency impact if we enable extra batch capacity; keep numbers conservative.
- Add note to rollout playbook: "If >3 nodes hit 95% GPU mem for >2 hours, auto-scale +1 and alert #infra-ops" (propose as default).

Handy links for later:
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood-internal/d/gpu/cluster-usage
- Prometheus query for sustained mem usage: max_over_time(gpu_memory_used_bytes[2h]) / gpu_memory_total_bytes

Notes-to-self:
- Keep canary window 48h and include both short-chat and long-context evals.
- Remember to capture model seqlen distribution before/after scale to validate batching behavior.

Random todo (nice-to-have):
- Add small playbook snippet for on-call: quick GPU recovery steps (rebind kernel driver -> restart container runtime -> cordon & drain node).

End of scratchpad.
